honest_limit: Full facet variants (P8-01 to P8-06, P8-08) are SILHOUETTE crystals: face, eyes, muscle lines and cape/body separation are NOT preserved inside the facet fill, because colour is per-facet flat over the whole silhouette. Use P8-07 mix-base when the face/body must stay readable. This is stated, not hidden.
look: Faceted pink/cyan crystalline silhouette. Left-facing facets read cyan, right-facing facets read pink, centre reads purple.

parameters.apply_to_any_pose: Run build_crystallization.py build_plate() on any transparent rig plate: compute EDT normals, Voronoi facets, flat facet colour. Appose and arms-up are proven here; other poses are the same code path, not yet rendered.
parameters.facet_colour: Per-facet flat colour = mean estimated-normal colour of that facet. Vivid variant = saturation boost 1.6 away from grey.
parameters.glint: White dot at facet centroid where normal faces left (nx < -0.2), radius spacing/12, alpha 230
parameters.layering: Preset is an OVERLAY on a copy. Base art is never recoloured permanently. Alpha channel is copied verbatim from the plate.
parameters.mix_base: 50% facet + 50% base plate, preserves face/body detail
parameters.rim_outside: Cyan (0,200,255) ring, dilate-minus-mask, width 6px, ZERO pixels inside the silhouette

source: shading-upgrade-20261031/normal-map-apose-20261031.png — estimated normal map, NOT a rendered crystal character
source_method: Normals estimated from silhouette distance transform (raw EDT, Gaussian sigma 2, z-scale 1.5) + interior linework, same as shading upgrade. No true 3D character model exists.

variants.P8-06: Facet vivid + edges + glints — DEFAULT POWER-ON LOOK
variants.P8-07: Facet vivid 50% mixed with base plate — detail-preserving variant
